name: Band Close-Grip Pulldown
steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead, kneel facing the anchor, and grasp the band with your hands set close together and arms extended.
Sit tall on your knees with your core braced and chest lifted.
Pull your elbows smoothly downward close to your sides until your hands reach upper-chest height.
Extend your arms slowly back overhead under tension before beginning the next repetition.
tips: Keep your chest lifted without leaning far backward to heave the band down.
Squeeze your lats and pull your shoulders down away from your ears at the bottom.
